description: Resolve a grocery/pantry list to real products at one store (raw ingredients only — NOT restaurant food). STATELESS: every call REPLACES the list, so always send the complete list. Weight items take decimal quantity (0.5 = half lb) only when purchase_type is MEASUREMENT; eggs are per dozen. Verify resolved items[].name with the user before carting. Vague asks: cap at 20 items and show your picks.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

quantity.description: Count, or weight for measurement items (default 1)

servings.description: Only when the user says 'for N people' — display-only

store_id.description: Pin to a store (takes precedence over desired_mx_name)

name: build_grocery_list
